levels.surface: أبو يعقوب يوسف بن محمد بن زياد
أبو الحسن علي بن محمد بن سيار

notes: «أبويهما» (their two fathers) is a collective kinship word: relation.
«وكانا من الشيعة الإمامية» describes the two men and is left out.
The Imam named after «عن» is narrator. The commentary is the saying; the Sadiq's answer inside it is part of the matn, so no second link is added. Doubt noted, not ruled.
